## Pirate sharpshooter (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
Hobgoblin gunslinger (bolt ace) 6/rogue (sharpshooter) 4  
LE Medium humanoid (goblinoid)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +15  


**Defense**


**AC** 24, touch 17, flat-footed 17 (+5 armor, +4 Dex, +3 dodge, +2 shield)  
**hp** 124 (6d10+4d8+32)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +14, **Will** +6  
**Defensive Abilities** evasion, uncanny dodge  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** masterwork scimitar +12/+7 (1d6+1/18-20)  
**Ranged** +1 repeating heavy crossbow +16/+11 (1d10+6/17–20) or +13 (2d10+12/17-20)  
**Special Attacks** accuracy, crossbow training (heavy +1), deadly range 40 ft., deeds (sharp shoot, vigilant loading, shooter’s resolve, gunslinger’s initiative, gunslinger dodge, pistol–whip), grit (3), sneak attack +2d6  


**Tactics**


**Before Combat** During alerts, pirate sharpshooters drink their elixir of hiding, increasing their Stealth bonus to +37.  

**During Combat** Pirate sharpshooters use Stealth in combat, preferring to make a single attack each round with Deadly Aim and Vital Strike, and then returning to hiding (taking only a -10 penalty on Stealth checks when sniping). After 5 shots, they keep hidden while taking a full-round action to reload their repeating crossbow. They use their sharp shoot deed against heavily armored targets. If intruders are largely human, they load their case of human bane bolts, or begin combat with those bolts loaded if an alert has been raised, focusing their shots on human PCs. Pirate sharpshooters use the full attack action against opponents that keep their distance, remaining beyond sneak attack range.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 10, **Dex** 18, **Con** 16, **Int** 10, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 24  
**Feats** Expert Sharpshooter, Improved Critical (heavy crossbow), [Point-Blank Shot](../../rules/feats/point-blank-shot.md), Skill Focus (Stealth), Target of Opportunity, Vital Strike, [Weapon Focus (scimitar)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Deadly Aim](../../rules/feats/deadly-aim.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Point-Blank Shot and Precise Shot are one feat, Point-Blank Shot; Deadly Aim needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (scimitar), Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +17, Bluff +12, Climb +10, Perception +15, Stealth +27, Survival +13, Swim +5  
**Languages** Common, Goblin  
**SQ** rogue talents (combat trick, superior sharpshooter)  
**Combat Gear** potion of cure light wounds, elixir of hiding, potion of invisibility, 5 +1 human bane bolts, 2 tanglefoot bags; Other Gear +1 mithral chain shirt, +1 buckler, +1 repeating heavy crossbow with 40 bolts, masterwork scimitar, cloak of resistance +1, +2 belt of incredible dexterity, 10 gp
